model_annotation: This donut chart displays the distribution of data across two nested categorical dimensions: “Ambiguity Std (Outer)” and “Max Ambiguity (Inner)”. The outer ring, representing “Ambiguity Std”, is divided into four segments with approximate proportions of 49.0%, 38.0%, 39.0%, and 14.2%, corresponding to standard deviation values of 0.47, 0.82, 0.94, and an obscured category, respectively. The inner ring, labeled “Max Ambiguity”, is segmented into three parts showing 47.7%, 7.0%, and 5.0%, corresponding to maximum ambiguity levels of 1, 2, and 3. The chart uses shades of blue to distinguish categories, with a legend on the right clarifying the mapping between color, label, and value for both rings. Percentages are displayed directly on the chart segments, and the segments appear to be ordered roughly by size within each ring.
